title: ChainWave
tagline: Our project is a smart platform for crypto users to monitor prices, receive real-time alerts, and perform cross-chain asset exchanges. It provides tools to help users make informed, timely decisions and manage multiple assets securely across chains.
description: This project is an advanced crypto management platform empowering users to track real-time token prices, receive instant notifications, and seamlessly execute auto cross-chain transactions. By combining multi-asset wallet support, intelligent alerts, and optimized exchange services, it ensures a secure, efficient, and user-friendly experience.
how_its_made:
Our project integrates multiple technologies to provide a seamless crypto asset management experience. It leverages Worldcoin ID for secure user login and uses Sign Protocol attestation to bind wallet addresses to World ID. Additionally, it supports parsing wallet ENS domains, enhancing personalization.

Our project offers real-time cross-chain solutions, allowing users to choose between automated cross-chain operations or manual triggers. At the same time, Push Protocol provides real-time price notifications. We utilize Circle CCTP to enable cross-chain functionality and integrate Uniswap for token swaps. Blockscout is used to display multichain assets, making it easier for users to monitor their asset status.
